utilize.definitionKo: 어떤 대상이 가지고 있는 쓰임이나 능력을 충분히 잘 이용하다.
utilize.englishDescription: To make full use of a function or an ability possessed by a certain object.

utilize.definitionKo: 대상을 필요에 따라 이롭거나 쓸모가 있게 쓰다.
utilize.englishDescription: To use something as occasion demands in a way that is helpful or beneficial to one.

vacation bonus.definitionKo: 직장 등에서 휴가를 얻은 사람에게 주는 돈.
vacation bonus.englishDescription: Money offered by a company to its employees who go on a vacation.

vacation season.englishDescription: The period in which many people go on a vacation.

value of one's ability.definitionKo: 어떤 사람의 능력을 기준으로 가치를 평가하여 돈으로 계산한 액수.
value of one's ability.englishDescription: The value of one's ability, measured in money after being evaluated.

venomously.definitionKo: 마음이나 성격이 매우 모질고 독하며 매서운 데가 있게.
venomously.englishDescription: In the manner of one's mind or personality being very cold and harsh.

venomously.definitionKo: 마음이나 성격이 매우 모질고 독하며 매섭게.
venomously.englishDescription: In the manner of one's mind or personality being very cold and harsh.

victim.englishDescription: A person who is dead or was killed.

victim.definitionKo: 자신의 생명이나 신체, 재산, 명예 등에 해를 입은 사람.
victim.englishDescription: A person who has suffered harm to his or her life, body, property, or reputation.
An innocent person who has been killed or hurt in an accident, disaster, etc.

victim.definitionKo: 사고나 자연재해 등으로 슬프고 안타깝게 목숨을 잃은 사람.
victim.englishDescription: A person who lost one's life in a sad and pitiful manner due to an accident, natural disaster, etc.

virus test kit.englishDescription: A tool to detect if you are infected with a disease or virus.

visual impairment.definitionKo: 눈에 이상이 생겨 앞을 보지 못하거나 시력이 떨어진 상태.
visual impairment.englishDescription: A condition in which one cannot see or has reduced vision due to an eye problem.

wait-and-see.definitionKo: 형편이나 분위기 등에 간섭하지 않고 멀리서 보기만 하는.
wait-and-see.englishDescription: Observing from a distance, not intervening in the situation or circumstances.

wallet.definitionKo: 돈, 카드, 명함 등을 넣어 가지고 다닐 수 있게 가죽이나 헝겊 등으로 만든 물건.
wallet.englishDescription: An object made of leather, cloth, etc., for carrying money, credit cards, business cards, etc.

warn.definitionKo: 위험한 일을 조심하거나 삼가도록 미리 일러서 주의를 주다.
warn.englishDescription: To caution someone in advance to be careful of or refrain from dangerous things.

warn.definitionKo: 남에게 경고, 암시 등을 하여 어떤 내용을 알 수 있게 하다.
warn.englishDescription: To give someone a warning or hint, so that he/she understands something.

waste matter.definitionKo: 생물의 몸에 들어온 여러 물질 중 필요한 것을 흡수하여 쓰고 남은 찌꺼기.
waste matter.englishDescription: Waste that an organism releases after taking in substances and absorbing the necessary nutrients.

wasting time.definitionKo: 하는 일 없이 세월을 헛되이 보냄.
wasting time.englishDescription: An act of spending one's time uselessly, doing nothing.
wasting time.englishExpression: idling away; wasting time; killing time

watch for.englishDescription: To wait for or seek an appropriate time.

watch for.definitionKo: 무엇을 이루기 위해 노력하면서 기회를 살피다.
watch for.englishDescription: To look for a chance while trying hard to achieve something.

watch for.definitionKo: 사람을 해치거나 물건을 뺏기 위한 나쁜 목적을 갖고 기회를 엿보다.
watch for.englishDescription: To look for a chance to achieve a malignant purpose of harming another person or taking his/her goods.

watch for.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하려고 마음을 단단히 먹고 기다리다.
watch for.englishDescription: To wait and see for something, being determined to do it.
watch for.englishExpression: look forward to; be determined; watch for

watch for an opportunity.definitionKo: 남의 것을 빼앗기 위해 상황을 살피며 가만히 기회를 엿보다.
watch for an opportunity.englishDescription: To watch a situation and wait quietly for an opportunity to take another's possessions.
watch for an opportunity.englishExpression: watch for an opportunity; be on alert for an opportunity

water supply source.definitionKo: 수도관을 통해 흘러나오는 물의 근원인 강이나 호수.
water supply source.englishDescription: A river or lake that serves as a source of water supplied through water mains.

wear ragged clothes.definitionKo: 가난하여 옷이 다 해지고 낡아 벗다시피 하다.
wear ragged clothes.englishDescription: Wearing old and tattered clothes out of poverty, making one look almost naked.

well begun is half done.definitionKo: 일을 시작하기가 어렵지 일단 시작하면 끝내기는 그렇게 어렵지 않다는 말.
well begun is half done.englishDescription: It is difficult to start something, but it is not that difficult to finish it once started.
well begun is half done.englishExpression: The beginning is half of something; A good beginning is half the battle; Well begun is half done

annotations: 남의 말을 긍정하여 그럴 듯도 하다는 뜻으로 쓴다.

whoa.definitionKo: 소나 말을 멈추게 하거나 가만히 있으라고 달래는 소리.
whoa.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered to soothe and stop a cow or horse.

whoa.definitionKo: 매우 아프거나 힘들거나 놀라거나 기막힐 때 내는 소리.
whoa.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker is aching, exhausted, surprised, or stunned.

whoa.definitionKo: 매우 심하게 아프거나 힘들거나 놀라거나 기막힐 때 내는 소리.
whoa.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker is very severely aching, exhausted, surprised, or stunned.

whoa.definitionKo: 매우 아프거나 힘들거나 분하거나 기막힐 때 내는 소리.
whoa.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker is aching, exhausted, vexed, or stunned.

whoa.definitionKo: 짐승을 몰거나 뒤쫓을 때 내는 소리.
whoa.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when driving or hunting for animals.

whoa.definitionKo: 소나 말을 멈추게 하거나 가만히 있으라고 달래는 소리.
whoa.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered to soothe and stop a cow or horse.

wife.englishDescription: (affectionate) One's wife who is past middle-age.
The man's female partner in marriage.
A woman who just got married.
A term meaning one's wife, home, family, etc.

wife.definitionKo: (낮추는 말로) 자식이 있는 남자가 웃어른 앞에서 자기 아내를 이르는 말.
wife.englishDescription: (impolite form) A word used by a man who has children to refer to his wife when talking to his elders.
A woman who got married to and became the spouse of a man.
A man's female partner in marriage.

willpower.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 이루고자 하는 마음을 꿋꿋하게 지켜 나가는 힘.
willpower.englishDescription: The power of keeping one's will to achieve something.

win back.englishDescription: To take back something that has been taken away.

win by decision.definitionKo: 권투, 유도, 레슬링 등의 경기에서 심판의 판정으로 이기다.
win by decision.englishDescription: To win a match in a sport such as boxing, judo, wrestling, etc., by the decision of a judge or judges.

winding.definitionKo: 모양이 곧지 않고 이리저리 구부러져 있다.
winding.englishDescription: Curved here and there, not straight.

winding.definitionKo: 모양이 곧지 않고 이리저리 구부러져 있다.
winding.englishDescription: Curved here and there, not straight.

winding.definitionKo: 곧거나 바르지 않고 이리저리 기울어지거나 구부러져 있다.
winding.englishDescription: Tilted or crooked in places, not straight.

wisdom tooth.definitionKo: 어금니가 다 난 뒤에 어른이 되어 맨 안쪽 끝에 새로 나는 어금니.
wisdom tooth.englishDescription: A molar newly appearing at the far end of the mouth later in life.

with a munching sound.definitionKo: 과자나 배, 사과 등을 씹을 때 나는 소리.
with a munching sound.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a cookie, pear, apple, etc., is being chewed.

with a munching sound.definitionKo: 과자나 배, 사과 등을 계속 씹을 때 나는 소리.
with a munching sound.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when a cookie, pear, apple, etc., is repeatedly chewed.

with crunching sounds.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound of stepping on snow continuously.

with crunching sounds.definitionKo: 과일이나 과자 등을 계속해서 씹어서 부스러지는 소리.
with crunching sounds.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound of a fruit, biscuit, etc., being chewed and broken continuously.

with honks.definitionKo: 자동차나 배 등에서 경적이 잇따라 울리는 소리.
with honks.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made repeatedly when a car, ship, etc., honks once.

with rustling sounds.definitionKo: 뻣뻣한 옷감이나 풀, 나뭇가지 등이 서로 계속해서 스치는 소리.
with rustling sounds.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound of stiff fabrics, blades of grass, branches, etc., brushing against each other continuously

woman reporter.englishDescription: A news reporter who is female.

wrap-up.definitionKo: 일정한 기간 동안에 한 일의 결과를 정리하는 것.
wrap-up.englishDescription: The act of recording the result of what one has done for a certain period.
An act of wrapping up a certain task, or such a result.

wrapped kimchi.definitionKo: 일정한 크기로 썬 무나 채소 등에 여러 가지 양념을 한 뒤 넓은 배추 잎으로 싸서 담근 김치.
wrapped kimchi.englishDescription: Kimchi made by seasoning radishes, vegetables, etc., sliced in fixed sizes, and wrapping them with a large kimchi cabbage leaf.

written language.definitionKo: 일상적인 대화가 아닌 글에서 쓰는 말.
written language.englishDescription: Words used in writings, not for casual conversation.
The language as expressed in letters.
entryAnnotations: 붙여쓰기를 허용한다.

written language.definitionKo: 일상적인 대화가 아닌 글에서 쓰는 말.
written language.englishDescription: Words used in writings, not for casual conversation.

yackety-yak.definitionKo: 여러 사람이 모여 시끄럽게 자꾸 떠드는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
yackety-yak.englishDescription: A word mimicking the sound of people chattering loudly, or such a sight.

yemen.definitionKo: 서남아시아의 아라비아반도 끝에 있는 나라. 농업, 목축업 등이 발달했으며 특히 모카커피의 산지로 유명하다. 공용어는 아랍어이고 수도는 사나이다.
yemen.englishDescription: A country located at the end of the  Arabian Peninsular in southwestern Asia; it is known for well-developed agriculture and livestock farming, and is a major produce of Mocha coffee; its official language is Arabic and its capital is Sana'a.

your excellency.definitionKo: 특정한 높은 지위의 관료를 높여 부르는 말.
your excellency.englishDescription: A word used to refer to or address high-ranking officials.
your excellency.englishExpression: Your Excellency; Your Grace; Your Honor
